settingsReady.title: Business settings
settingsReady.subtitle: Configure the pharmacy, branch and daily operating defaults.
settingsReady.name: Pharmacy / business name
settingsReady.countryHint: Two-letter ISO country code, for example BJ or CA.
settingsReady.currencyHint: Three-letter ISO currency. One currency per pharmacy; changes are rejected once a batch, purchase order or sale exists. No conversion is performed.
settingsReady.timezoneHint: IANA timezone, for example Africa/Porto-Novo, America/Toronto or UTC. Branches inherit this unless overridden.
settingsReady.profileLimit: Address, phone and email belong to branches in the current model and appear on receipts. A business tax/registration identifier and logo are not modeled.
settingsReady.taxLimit: Tax calculation and tax configuration are not supported by the current model. No tax is added automatically.
settingsReady.saved: Saved. The configured values are now available to workflows.
settingsReady.saveFailed: Save could not be confirmed. Your entries are preserved; retry to confirm the same record.
settingsReady.loadFailed: Settings could not be loaded. Retry before editing.
settingsReady.offline: Offline or cached settings. Connect and reload before saving.
settingsReady.readOnly: Business and branch changes require the corresponding management permission. You can still choose your branch and language and manage your own available preferences.
settingsReady.currencyMissing: Business currency is missing. Ask an owner to configure it before recording amounts.
settingsReady.branchChoiceHint: Your selected active branch is remembered on this device for this account. If access changes, the first available active branch is used. No shared default branch is modeled.
settingsReady.branchTimezoneHint: Optional IANA override. Leave empty to inherit {{zone}}. Used by reports and receipt dates.
settingsReady.branchStatusHint: Inactive branches are excluded from operational branch selection; existing records and access assignments are retained.
settingsReady.receiptHint: Current business name, branch address/contact and this footer appear in the receipt and print view. Previously completed sales keep their recorded currency.
settingsReady.lowStockHint: One global threshold, applied to summed sellable availability per product in the branch (not per batch). Low stock: greater than zero and at or below this value. Up to 4 decimals; dot or comma accepted. Missing balances remain unknown.
settingsReady.paymentHint: Initial choice for a new POS sale; cashiers may override it. Card/mobile/bank methods record external payments; they do not process them. An unavailable default falls back to cash, then the first supported method.
settingsReady.expiryHint: Comma-separated positive whole days, up to 10. Expiring soon means within the largest threshold; the nearest matching band labels each batch. Shared by the expiry worklist, dashboard and default report window. In-app follow-ups refresh throughout the app and close when no longer applicable.
settingsReady.reportExpiryHint: Default expiry window uses the largest configured warning threshold. A report filter is a temporary override. Reports are limited to a 3,650-day warning window.
settingsReady.inAppHint: Controls future operational in-app notifications for this account. History remains readable; turning this off closes current follow-ups on refresh.
settingsReady.deliveryUnavailable: Email, SMS, WhatsApp and push delivery are unavailable. Previously stored external-channel preferences are retained but do not send messages.
settingsReady.languageHint: English / French is remembered on this device and updates receipt presentation and document language immediately. Quantities and money use the selected language; dates use the configured branch timezone.

errors.SETTINGS_TIMEZONE_INVALID: Enter a valid IANA timezone, for example Africa/Porto-Novo or UTC.
errors.SETTINGS_CURRENCY_INVALID: Enter a supported three-letter ISO currency code.
errors.SETTINGS_CURRENCY_LOCKED: Currency cannot change after a batch, purchase order or sale exists. Existing amounts are never converted or relabeled.
errors.SETTINGS_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: This transaction currency differs from the pharmacy currency. Reload the business context before retrying.
errors.SETTINGS_THRESHOLD_INVALID: Enter a non-negative threshold with up to 4 decimal places.
errors.SETTINGS_COUNTRY_INVALID: Enter a two-letter country code or leave it empty.
errors.SETTINGS_EMAIL_INVALID: Enter a valid branch email address or leave it empty.
errors.SETTINGS_REFRESH_REQUIRED: Saved, but the updated business context could not be loaded. Retry to confirm and refresh.
errors.INVALID_EXPIRY_THRESHOLDS: Enter 1–10 positive whole-day thresholds separated by commas.
errors.SETTINGS_LAST_BRANCH: Keep at least one active branch. Activate another branch before deactivating this one.
